authSide.heading: Run every garage from one place.
authSide.point1: Create garages and invite their owners

account.title: Account
account.name: Name
account.offHint: Optional but recommended: sign-in will also ask for a 6-digit code from an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy, so a stolen password alone is not enough.
account.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
account.manual: Cannot scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
account.turnOffHint: To turn it off, confirm with a current code from the app or a recovery code.

verify.title: Two-factor authentication
verify.useCode: Use the code from the app instead
verify.codeInvalid: Enter the 6 digits shown in the app.
verify.recoveryInvalid: Enter a recovery code, for example 3f9a1-c07be.

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now and cannot be shown again.
recovery.saved: I saved these codes somewhere safe

garageForm.title: New garage
garageForm.name: Business name
garageForm.emailHint: The owner signs in with this email and receives the invite here.

invalid.name: Enter the business name (2 to 120 characters).
invalid.phone: Enter a valid phone number, for example 03 123 456 or +961 3 123 456.
invalid.timezone: Enter a valid time zone, for example Asia/Beirut.
invalid.paidUntil: Choose today or a later date.

garageDetail.noOwner: This garage has no owner account.
garageDetail.invitePending: Has not accepted the invite yet
garageDetail.inviteSent: A new invite was sent to {email}.
garageDetail.resetSent: A password reset link was sent to {email}.
garageDetail.suspendHint: A suspended garage is locked on its next request. Nothing is deleted.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.priceHint: Price: {year} a year + {branches} extra {branches, plural, one {branch} other {branches}} × {branch} = {total}
subscription.newExpiryHint: Suggested: 12 months after the current paid period, or from today.
subscription.paymentSaved: Payment recorded. The garage is paid until {date}.
subscription.extendHint: The trial ends on {date}. Only a garage that has never paid can be extended.

invalid.amount: Enter an amount, for example 200 or 200.50.
invalid.paidOn: Choose a date that is not in the future.
invalid.newExpiryDate: Choose today or later, and not before the payment date.
invalid.trialEndsOn: Choose a day after the current trial end, today or later.

viewAs.title: View as garage
viewAs.hint: Opens the garage's own app in a new tab, read only, for one hour. Every page you open is logged.

applications.title: Applications
applications.approveHint: Approving opens the new garage form, filled in from this application. Creating the garage sends the owner's invite.
applications.earlier: Earlier applications from this email or phone
applications.approveIntro: Check the details and create the garage. They asked for {branches, plural, one {# branch} other {# branches}}; extra branches are added by the owner later.
applications.alreadyReviewed: This application was already approved or rejected.

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.paidEnding: Paid periods ending in the next 3 weeks
monitoring.trialsEnding: Trials ending in the next 7 days
monitoring.usageNote: Messages and invoices count this month. Counts only: customers' details stay with their garage.
monitoring.failuresHint: Messages that could not be sent, newest first. The recipient and the text stay with the garage.
monitoring.failureCount: {count, plural, one {# failed message} other {# failed messages}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.readOnly: Only a super admin can change these settings.

fields.extraBranchPriceCents: Price per extra branch, per year (USD)
fields.reminderMaxPerGaragePerMonth: Reminder emails per garage per month
fields.defaultDailyKm: Daily km of a car with no history

hints.trialDays: For garages created from now on.
hints.reminderDaytimeEndHour: Garage time, not included; after the start.

settings.saved: Settings saved. They apply within a minute.

serviceTypes.title: Default service types
serviceTypes.hint: Every garage starts from these. A garage that changed a type keeps its own version; a hidden type is no longer offered.
serviceTypes.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and _; it never changes.

branchAdmin.title: Branches
branchAdmin.hint: Only Gearva adds branches or switches them on and off; each extra branch is billed. The garage owner can edit the name, address and phone.
branchAdmin.staff: {count, plural, =0 {No active staff} one {# active staff member} other {# active staff}}
branchAdmin.name: Name
branchAdmin.superOnly: Only a super admin adds branches or changes them.

users.title: Users
users.lead: Gearva admins, every garage's staff and the car owners with the app.
users.superOnly: Only a super admin can open this page.
users.adminCreated: {name} was added. Give them their password; they can turn on 2FA from their Account page.
users.deactivated: Switched off. Their sessions were ended.
users.totpReset: 2FA turned off. They can turn it on again from their Account page.
users.newPasswordHint: At least {min} characters. Tell it to the person; all their sessions end.
users.passwordSet: Password set. Their sessions were ended and any old link no longer works.
users.ownerHint: A garage owner is not switched off here: suspend the garage instead.
users.ownersPrivacy: Personal data of the garages' customers: each time this list is opened, it is written to the audit log.
users.noLogin: No app login yet: a garage must invite this person first.
users.closeHint: The login email, password and phones are removed. The garages keep their records and can invite the person again.
users.signOutHint: Ends every session on every device now. The password stays the same.
users.signedOut: {count, plural, =0 {No open session was found.} one {Signed out of # session.} other {Signed out of # sessions.}}

audit.title: Audit log
audit.lead: Who did what, when, and to which record: Gearva admins, garage staff, car owners and automatic jobs.
audit.superOnly: Only a super admin can open this page.
audit.oneGarage: Showing one garage only. Open Audit log from the menu to see everything.
audit.accessLead: Every page an admin opened inside a garage with "View as". The page address is kept, never the data.
audit.noChanges: No details were saved for this action.

announcements.title: Messages
announcements.lead: Send a message to garages. It shows at the top of the Gearva app for every staff member until they close it, and can also be emailed to each garage owner.
announcements.superOnly: Only a super admin can open this page.
announcements.languageHint: Write in the language the garages read; it is sent as you write it.
announcements.picked: {count, plural, one {# garage chosen} other {# garages chosen}}
announcements.showUntilHint: Leave empty to show it until each person closes it.
announcements.sent: {garages, plural, one {Sent to # garage.} other {Sent to # garages.}}
announcements.closedBy: {count, plural, =0 {closed by nobody yet} one {closed by # person} other {closed by # people}}
